data.desc: Harmony Biosciences is developing and commercializing innovative medicines for both rare and broad CNS disorders, and we are becoming an enduring leader in neuroscience. Our first medicine, WAKIX (pitolisant), is the first and only FDA-approved non-scheduled treatment for excessive daytime sleepiness or cataplexy in patients 6 years of age and older with narcolepsy. Its launch ranks among the most successful in the history of orphan drugs. Building on our success and profitability, we are continuing to advance our novel clinical-stage pipeline, led by BP-205, an investigational orexin-2 receptor agonist with best-in-class potential across a broad range of CNS disorders. With a strong balance sheet, we have the capacity and conviction to pursue strategic business development opportunities. Harmony is guided by an unwavering commitment to patients and driven to create long-term value for shareholders.
